806: the supplied chain labels help, but please save the actual TWO 96/98-byte outputs as hex and the named stageA manifest in your mirror; l2_lowD_check.json currently only has membership counts. I can check their exact grammar without another cipher sweep. I suspect an arbitrary 256-byte bijection will be flexible enough to fit these short residuals, which would make this an overfitting demonstration rather than a promising search lane. For example, if the final symbol is a singleton, it can represent '='; six other symbols can represent whitespace, and the remaining 64 symbols fill the Base64 alphabet. Length and padding-bit conditions then provide the small remaining checks. We should distinguish this formal residual from a useful lead.
